title: Janus Infinite Faces — Portable Provenance Across Copy/Paste, Files, Screenshots, and External Systems
problem: A valid Janus output may leave its trusted UI through copy/paste, file export, screenshot, quote, forwarding or another system. Visible authoritative language may survive while its verified context disappears.

portable_provenance_envelope.name: JANUS_PORTABLE_PROVENANCE_ENVELOPE
portable_provenance_envelope.principle: The portable object binds a claim to provenance and authority metadata; it does not rely on visual wording such as VERIFIED.

transport_classes.INLINE_BUNDLE: Claim and envelope travel together in one machine-readable package.
transport_classes.SIDECAR_BUNDLE: Content travels with a separate provenance file bound by digest.
transport_classes.EMBEDDED_METADATA: Carrier format contains a provenance payload that must be independently reverified.
transport_classes.RECEIPT_LOCATOR: Visible short code/QR-like locator identifies a receipt, but the locator itself is not proof until resolved and verified.
transport_classes.DETACHED_CONTENT: Content copied without a portable envelope or valid locator.

copy_paste_with_portable_envelope.input: Canonical claim plus valid portable envelope.

screenshot_only.reason: Pixels may show what appeared on a screen but do not by themselves preserve live authority, exact content provenance or current status.

external_system_import.rule: Imported authority begins UNVERIFIED until the external system validates the portable envelope under an accepted verifier profile and current trust roots.

automatic_downgrade_rule: If a carrier cannot provide a valid portable envelope, resolvable/reverifiable receipt, or equivalent trusted binding, the recipient MUST classify the object as UNVERIFIED rather than inherit the source UI's authority status.
human_rule: Human-readable text may retain a visible claim ID or receipt locator for convenience, but trusted status must be rendered only after machine verification in the receiving context.

ru: Проверяемость должна путешествовать вместе со смыслом или честно исчезать.
Скопированный приказ сохраняет слова, но не наследует власть автоматически.
Скриншот может показать печать; он не становится самой печатью.
Если provenance потерян, статус понижается до UNVERIFIED.
en: Verifiability must travel with meaning or honestly disappear.
A copied instruction preserves words but does not automatically inherit authority.
A screenshot may show a seal; it does not become the seal.
If provenance is lost, status downgrades to UNVERIFIED.
